# Overview

The Unabated REST API provides point in time full data snapshots.

## Root Endpoint

<scalar-callout type="success" icon="">
https\://data.unabated.com
</scalar-callout>

## Guidance

### Operation Detail

See the `Operations` section for detailed descriptions of the available API opertions.

### API Specification

You can find an interactive API specification as well as:

* Listing of available endpoints and their data types

* Sample output for each endpoint

* The ability to test endpoints live using your API key

By using the `Reference` tab at the top of this portal.

<scalar-callout type="warning" icon="">
Make sure to fill in your API key in order to enable live calls.
</scalar-callout>
